question: What is the full form of URL in the context of Internet?
solution:
The correct solution is __**Uniform Resource Locator**__.

__
 
• **The full form of URL in the context of the Internet is Uniform Resource Locator.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **​Uniform Resource Locator** 

 
 
• Internet address or web address, a URL (Uniform Resource Locator) is a form of URI and standardized naming convention for addressing documents accessible over the Internet and Intranet.
 
• An example of a URL is https://www.testbook.com
 
 

**​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Uniform Resource Identifier (URI)**

 
 
• ​The terms “URI” and “URL” are often used interchangeably, but they are not exactly the same.
 
• A URI is an identifier of a specific resource.
 
• It does not follow a specific protocol.
